/**
 * A whole file with a `.test.` infix, skipped by its path before anything in it
 * is walked. Its functions branch so that scoring it would be visible.
 */

import { describe as describeNumber } from "./probe";

function band(n: number): string {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  }
  return n === 0 ? "zero" : "positive";
}

test("bands are named", () => {
  for (const n of [-1, 0, 1]) {
    expect(band(n)).not.toBe("");
  }
  expect(describeNumber(0)).toBe("zero");
});
